JSON-LD script tag is stripped from output (security) but metadata may be extracted

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<html><head><title>Article</title><script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Article\",\"headline\":\"My Article\",\"author\":{\"@type\":\"Person\",\"name\":\"Jane Doe\"},\"datePublished\":\"2024-01-15\"}</script></head><body><h1>My Article</h1><p>Article body text.</p></body></html>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
